details: Adds a Protobuf tab to message viewers, Replay, Fuzzer, and Intercept. It decodes raw protobuf bodies, gRPC and gRPC-web frames (including grpc-web-text and gzip-compressed frames), and bodies that are entirely base64 protobuf, inferring field types without a .proto file. Edit the 'number: type value' lines and the plugin re-encodes the payload, rebuilding frame lengths, base64, and Content-Length. Binary bodies are byte-exact only with a protobuf or gRPC Content-Type. Includes a Decoder codec. The plugin sends no requests.
